default_control.lock_sessions: short batches for the first ten boots; remaining twelve in one session
default_control.inter_batch_gaps: not fixed; include lock acquisition and one orchestration recovery
default_control.recovery: host-side controller ended; remote completed its current two-boot batch. Ten complete successful records were confirmed before resuming at index ten. No failed or duplicate row was removed.

thp_and_allocation_only: each ran as one uninterrupted 22-boot diagnostic session
production_acceptance: one uninterrupted 22-boot run; no diagnostic boot arguments
counter_scope: VMM process totals sampled after KG_READY, not counters confined to the timed first-command interval
